item.title: Highest
item.description: The Atugan Bridge in Impasug-ong, Bukidnon is said to be the highest bridge in Mindanao at 64.5 meters. The head water of Atugan River lies between Mt. Kitanglad and Mt. Dulangdulang, both of which belong to the Mt. Kitanglad Mountain Range seen in the background. Photographed Sunday (14 December 2025). MindaNews photo by BOBBY TIMONERA
